capabilities: Style graph nodes with CSS, YAML, a style pane, and images
Build, pin, save, and reload a workspace graph of selected nodes
Expand or hide nodes selectively and choose among 4 layouts
Display graphs inside notes via a code block
extras: Further documentation lives on juggl.io; the plugin exposes an API for other plugins to extend it, and it works on mobile.
intentEvidence: Juggl has many features unique to its graph view compared to the Obsidian graph view
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view offers limited styling and control, making it hard to navigate or curate a focused subset of nodes.

relations.evidence: Tight integration with the very useful Breadcrumbs plugin
Complete control over the style of your graph using the powerful Cytoscape.js library

summary: Interactive, stylable, expandable graph view with a workspace mode, multiple layouts, and in-note graph code blocks, built on Cytoscape.js.
